registration_scope: before F feature build or model scoring; earlier A and P validation observed
weights: positive minutes in the most recent prior team match, normalized within that side
performance_history: same team's previous five matches in current season; no cross-club or cross-season identity inference
formula_rates: sum over last prior match participants of w_i * 90 * G_i/(M_i+180), and analogous A_i; M/G/A summed in prior window
formula_group_share: sum of G_i+A_i in window for positive-minute participants in last prior match / all window G+A; missing if denominator=0
eligible_history: strictly prior local calendar days, via P_usage_v1 lineage
missing_policy: all four missing without history; rates may be zero with history; contribution ratios missing if no contribution
